dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave spline fitted to the trailing edge, forming a sharp hook-like curvature from the apex to the posterior base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a moderate pixel radius, forming a smooth transition between the leading and trailing edges.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Relatively constant linear slope at approximately 35-40 degrees relative to the horizontal base axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width is approximately 1.4 times greater than the vertical pixel height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple vertical white linear striations (rake marks) located on the upper third of the trailing edge; a horizontal row of small white punctate scars visible near the mid-base of the fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique cluster of parallel vertical scars concentrated specifically at the distal trailing edge margin.
